thread:
claire (Growth): Quick heads-up: we need a compact battlecard + routing play for the launch email cohort. Timebox: 2 hours.
ryan (Field): Good. Field asks: make 2 SDR plays per competitor bucket and a one-sentence economic soundbite. Keep the infra vendor line visceral (ops pain).
anya (Content): I'll draft hero lines for webinar + one-liner social variants. Want A/B for 'econ-first' vs 'trust-first'.
louis (Product PM): Benchmark guidance: don't give exact p99s publicly. Use customer-observed ranges and 'typical production' phrasing. For slides, show a small appendix with methodology.
claire (Growth): For routing: need intent rules so SDRs and Intercom can triage inbound quickly. Also add a default play when customers mention multiple intents.
ryan (Field): Example micro-rebut phrasing (short):
- vs cloud AI platforms: "Predictable unit economics + SLA fallbacks when capacity shifts."
- vs LLM APIs: "More than model access  a single runtime for consistent behavior and rollouts."
- vs infra vendors: "You get control without the ops team burnout."
anya (Content): I'll run the copy tight. Social hero candidates:
- Econ: "Lower inference spend. Keep quality. Join our benchmarks."
- Runtime: "One API that runs anywhere  hosted, dedicated, private."
louis (Product PM): For the webinar narrative: start with a 60s econ story (billing surprise > ops overhead) -> quick demo of routing/fallback -> appendix link to perf methodology. CTA split: demo signups vs enterprise contact.
claire (Growth): SDR scripts: short cold and reply plays. Please keep them <2 lines each.
ryan (Field): Cold opener (example): "Quick Q: are inference bills surprising you month-to-month? We map model runs to dollars. 15m?"
anya (Content): Reply play when prospect says "we self-host": "Totally. Many teams keep self-hosting but standardize runtime with Redwood to reduce ops risk. Can I show a 5-min side-by-side?"
claire (Growth): Routing YAML snippet (copyable for Intercom/HubSpot):
```
intent_routes:
  - intent: "compliance"
    destination: "private_deck"
  - intent: "cost"
    destination: "benchmark_blog"
  - intent: "self_host"
    destination: "dedicated_trial"
  - intent: "latency"
    destination: "perf_demo"
  - intent: "multiple"
    destination: "hand_off_sdr"
```
louis (Product PM): Good. Add note: if 'multiple' is detected, route to senior SDR with a short summary: top 2 intents. We'll include that in the playbook.
anya (Content): Micro Scripting for SDRs (2-liners):
- Cloud AI skeptic cold: "Saw teams hit surprise egress & model surcharges. We map runs to dollars and demo in 15m. Interested?"
- Infra vendor reply: "I get it  controlling infra is valuable. We help reduce integration debt and tail latency without losing control. Quick ping?"
ryan (Field): Field example to include in battlecard (20 words): "Stitching multiple vendor SDKs caused integration regressions and doubled incident MTTR during a model update." Keep it anonymous.
claire (Growth): flowbot: assets check?
flowbot: Webinar repo updated -> /drive/webinar/launch-v3 (permissions: marketing,sales)
anya (Content): Action items recap: 1) @anya: two hero lines + social variants (EOD). 2) @louis: appendix draft + routing note (tomorrow AM). 3) @ryan: 3 field bullets & infra example (tomorrow). 4) @claire: assemble battlecard + drop in #sales-assets. Review tomorrow 09:30 PT.
claire (Growth): Keeping thread short. Post updates as replies here and ping me when assets are in. :sparkles:
